policy_consumption: Production geometry consumers: Disclosure render_icon_label consumes Row.main_axis/cross_axis through layout_measured_children; IconView consumes IconArtboard.main_axis/cross_axis through the helper. Text consumers: NumberField stepper consumes ButtonContent.text_alignment, ChartView consumes ChartLabel.text_alignment. Column and TextRow remain helper/unit-test only. Row.text_alignment, IconArtboard.text_alignment, ButtonContent.main_axis/cross_axis and ChartLabel.main_axis/cross_axis are not production consumers. FirstBaseline has helper/tests only; first-line-box indicator alignment in Checkbox/RadioGroup/Switch is not typographic baseline alignment. No 45-component adoption claim.

findings.original_finding: Original header measured before sort glyph decoration, with fixed first row y+40; wrapped header overlapped rows.
findings.resolution: Build final header_labels before measure; shared header_band drives all header frames; row_start=header_band+6 and content_height consume row_start.
findings.evidence: collections_view.rs:827-945; pixels and real native input not accepted by this source review.

findings.original_finding: Title measured at unconstrained content_width but drawn at min(width,420); short frame clamped action upward over detail.
findings.resolution: title_width=min(content_width,420) used for both; action remains after detail when it cannot fit. Parent clips overflow; no overlap fallback.

findings.original_finding: Standalone plus/minus buttons requested Leading alignment.
findings.resolution: Both use button_text_align(BUTTON_CONTENT), whose current text_alignment is center.
findings.evidence: feedback_view.rs:587,599; centered by supplied policy, not a baseline claim.

findings.original_finding: Branch chevrons were glyph prefixes in the row label. First replacement retained stale icon_slots on hidden early return.
findings.resolution: Node label measured/drawn separately from fixed branch icon slot; icon_slots.clear() precedes all early exits.
findings.evidence: collections_view.rs:480 onward; render_icons sends canonical chevron-down/right to IconView.

findings.original_finding: New separate render_icons pass does not retain the frame/own_clip used by render. Offscreen branch rows remain in icon_slots and can paint outside Tree frame.
findings.reproduction: Expanded root plus expanded child branch; render with frame height34 and clip=None, then render_icons with clip=None. Second branch icon at y38 is outside component frame but still painted, whereas row hit geometry is absent. Partial rows also need original clip preserved.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain render own_clip/per-row visible rectangle in icon slots, intersect with caller clip during render_icons, and skip invisible slots.
findings.resolution: TreeIconSlot retains button_layout.visible. render_icons intersects original row visible with caller clip, skips invisible rows, and keeps partial-row clipping; slots clear at render entry.
findings.evidence: collections_view.rs TreeIconSlot/render_icons; test source tree_icon_render_reuses_full_and_partial_row_clips inspected. Executed validation belongs to parent.

findings.original_finding: New instruction helper measured wrapped caption height but painted via unwrapped one-line line helper.
findings.resolution: place_instruction_below_rows now shapes proposal_label(Caption,Some(bounds.width)) and paints proposal_wrapped_in at same width/role; starts after measured row bottom; omits note if viewport cannot contain it.
findings.evidence: extended/collections_adapter.rs helper and Scene Glyphs multiline y-position test source inspected.

findings.component: toast Gallery adapter and production view
findings.original_finding: Toast dismiss/message dimensions and fixed fixture controls could clip/overlap after large text growth; measured multiline fixture captions still used one-line painting.
findings.resolution: ToastView::measure/render use same dismiss/action and message width. Gallery frame consumes measured height, controls start after toast bottom, note follows max(action,timer) bottom; captions exceeding legacy line slot use same-width wrapped painting.
findings.evidence: feedback_view.rs ToastView measure/render and extended/feedback_adapter.rs draw_measured_caption/toast_fixture_layout inspected; 100/125/150 percent scope.

findings.original_finding: Parent PNG review found a localized three-line caption colliding with the preview after type scaling; card height, scroll extent and lazy preparation needed shared scaled geometry.
findings.resolution: scaled_tile_height=148*normalized_type_scale; scaled_row_step adds existing 16pt gap. build_catalog, extent_at_scale and visible_legacy_at_scale share tile_rect_at_scale/scaled_row_step. Existing extent/visible_legacy wrappers pass 1.0. Gallery prepare and extent derive scale directly from Workbench model, while build sets TextEngine from the same model before drawing. Caption/title are measured and wrapped at matching widths.
findings.evidence: Limited inspection of pages/icons.rs scaled layout/build/extent/lazy functions and three-line caption plus last-row test source; mod.rs prepare/extent/model-scale handoff. Parent reported 8 pass / 1 ignore; reviewer did not execute tests or accept PNGs.
